title: AI Agents
shortDescription: Build intelligent agents that can reason, communicate, perform tasks and interact with business systems.
fullDescription: An agent is only useful when it can act. We build agents with a narrow, well-defined remit, real tool access into your systems, and hard guardrails around what they are permitted to do. Every agent ships with evaluation cases, structured logging of its reasoning and tool calls, and a fallback path to a human. We favour several focused agents over one that tries to do everything, because focused agents are testable.

deliverables.title: Agent architecture
deliverables.description: Clear responsibilities, tool boundaries, memory strategy and escalation rules, documented before code.

deliverables.title: Tool and system integrations
deliverables.description: Typed, permissioned access to your CRM, database, ticketing and internal APIs.

deliverables.title: Evaluation harness
deliverables.description: A regression suite of real scenarios so prompt and model changes are measured, not guessed.

deliverables.title: Observability
deliverables.description: Traced conversations, tool-call logs, token spend and quality scoring per agent.

useCases: Internal assistants that query and update business systems
Multi-agent pipelines where each step has a specialist
Customer-facing assistants with strict escalation rules
